positions.description: - CI/CD Pipeline management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building and maintaining a Rust-based service with endpoints for user and internal service management

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led technical strategy, key architectural decisions, and engineering execution to deliver impactful, scalable solutions. Key achievements included:
- Architecting and managing a PostgreSQL database, including schema design and a CI/CD pipeline for migrations.
- Planning and leading complex projects, guiding engineers to successful delivery.
- Building a design system in the codebase, streamlining a rebranding project.
- Implementing user authentication and management systems using Auth0 and Okta.
- Developing a HubSpot integration and framework for future integrations.
- Integrating ChatGPT to enhance AI content generation.
- Designing analytics pipelines for automation and insights.
- Establishing application performance monitoring, alerting, and incident management processes.

positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Large Language Models (LLM) · Google Gemini · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · OpenAI API · User Interface Design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered impactful technical solutions, improved operational efficiency, and fostered team growth through leadership and collaboration. Key contributions included:
- Led Integration Development: Designed and maintained a large number of data ingestion and outbound integrations, including building and optimizing the ingest pipeline to ensure scalability and reliability.
- Interim Team Manager: Stepped up as interim manager for a team of 7 engineers for three months, driving project delivery and supporting team development.
- Operational Efficiency Improvements: Reduced alert volume by an order of magnitude by refining alert calculations, delivering robust bug fixes, and fostering a culture of proactive monitoring and resolution.
- Defined Front-End Alerting Standards: Established company-wide front-end alerting best practices to improve system reliability and reduce noise.
- Incident Communication Enhancements: Led a cross-team working group to improve internal incident communication processes, ensuring transparency and faster resolution.
- Developer Experience Advocate: Guided discussions and initiatives to improve developer experience, increasing engineering productivity and satisfaction.
- Self-Serve Initiatives: Delivered several self-serve features, reducing support costs, boosting revenue, and driving product adoption through enhanced user empowerment.
This role highlighted my ability to lead teams, improve systems, and deliver business value through thoughtful technical and operational strategies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drove impactful solutions to improve key performance indicators by developing and maintaining reliable, scalable applications. Key contributions included:
- Full-Stack Development: Designed and implemented front-end features using ReactJS and backend services in Java to enhance product performance and user experience.
- Data-Driven Growth: Collaborated with stakeholders to identify and implement features that drove improvements in critical business metrics.
- System Reliability: Ensured application reliability through rigorous testing, performance optimization, and close attention to user feedback.
Senior Engineer – PHP & C Agent Team
- Delivered low-level, high-performance agent solutions to optimize data collection and enhance system efficiency. Key contributions included:
- Agent Development: Implemented efficient, low-level data structures in C to optimize agent performance for high-throughput systems.
- Build Automation: Developed Jenkins build pipelines to automate the creation of custom AIM images, streamlining deployment and testing processes.
- Multi-Language Expertise: Leveraged experience with PHP, Go, and C to create reliable, informative agents tailored to diverse environments.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Led an initiative to design a feature for seamless implementation across all language agents, ensuring clarity for users and compatibility with each agent.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I serve as a key member of the team, working towards code quality, reliability and sustainability. I personally increased test coverage by 233%. In addition to regular stories (frontend ui/REST/webservices/ APIs), I pushed for and implemented linters as well as improving automated tests. Interviewed and mentored interns. Technologies: Java (JUnit, Mockito), React, Angular, JavaScript Dependencies: (Karma, Mocha, Chai, Sinon, npm, Webpack), Python, AWS: (sqs, sns, s3, lambda), Bamboo Builds

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped plan and run the Act-W conference and volunteered for events like Agile in a Day and Girl Scout camp. Events like this help get young women interested in science and technology and show them that it’s a real possibility for them. I was also on the committee that started the first college chapter of ChickTech at Portland State. College chapters help young women network and enhance their education to set them up for success in their respective industries.
